g.text: Probe-update dose1 versus the identical sham trials. Left target evidence; right designated foil while target unchanged. Empirical fractions with
Wilson95% intervals. Small denominators per magnitude are explicit in trial records:64 TOTAL per condition, not64 per point. No threshold fit or
universal benefit is inferred from sparse points. Feature direction is absolute sin(2theta), not a learned rotation/decision direction.
